children: Robert Kiyosaki says his sixth money problem is going from too much money to no money, reversing his fifth: having too much money. He also lists having no money, earning too little, overspending and lacking future funds; according to BeInCrypto, he says sudden wealth can cause athletes, movie stars, lottery winners and heirs to lose fortunes through ego or dishonest managers, accountants, attorneys or relatives. Kiyosaki says he has experienced the cycle several times and views losses as lessons for those willing to learn. For crypto investors, he recommends setting risk limits before buying tokens; his Cashflow game, created with wife Kim, lets players practice with fake money.

title: Robert Kiyosaki Says Sixth Money Problem Is Falling From Wealth to Nothing
